scripts.build: npm run build -w @paprel/embed-core && npm run build -w @paprel/embed-ui && npm run build -w @paprel/embed-accounting && npm run build -w @paprel/embed-reports
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run build && node --import tsx --test scripts/*.test.ts
scripts.lint: npm run build && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
scripts.release: npm run lint && npm test && npm run pack:check && npm run consumer:check && changeset publish
